lens: Skeptic, geometry first; measure everything. Scripts and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/2fb1f2ef-fbd7-5fb9-b7d2-14a3db7265c8/scratchpad/raterA47. blend.py makes 50/50 blends and edge overlays of r47/q15-17 against y_47300/01/03. m2.py segments the near-headrest cover as a connected component (1.05<B/R<1.6, 75<L<190, opened) and writes covers.png. m3.py traces back tops and the fabric-to-shell edge. m4/m6.py take column white-run profiles through the near aisle arm and colour boxes (cap, belts, buckle). m1.py counts dark-neutral px (L 25-100, B/R<1.35). m7.py is the left-block pocket. w.py is the q15 head-on cover run, reused from raterA46. Before/after crops at the new camera: near17.png, arm17.png, belt17.png, left17.png and pocket17.png (render | photo | w46 geometry from r46c), plus studio_ba.png (s46 | s47). Note: the brief lists the candidate renders as S/r46/, but S/r46 holds the 09:05 w46 renders. The b65def4 renders are S/r47/ (09:27-09:29, pairs.json has the new q17 camera) and S/s47/, so I rated those. Their q15 and q17 differ from r46 and r46c only where the candidate changed.
calibrationNote: Down 0.05 from 8.45. The detail mean is 8.28 (w46 8.28). The candidate's own changes are real gains: the under-arm plates are 62 % fewer dark px, the belt layout now follows y_47303, the hood shelf is in, the card header is blue and the mesh is lit grey. The score does not rise because the re-matched q17 camera removes the excuse I gave the headrest in w46. Camera check (blend_q17.png, edges_q17.png): the low landmarks agree within about 5 px, namely the right-block arm noses, pan fronts and left-block arm noses. The upper landmarks sit consistently high: the near right back top is at y~125 against 152, and the near left screen top at 151 against 178, a +25-30 px offset. The left back's internal span (screen top to pocket bottom) is the same in both (277 vs 272 px). q15 head-on back tops also match within 3 px. So I read the +27 px as a residual camera error in vertical scale/pitch (integrator), not too-tall backs. The windows' 0.15 m phase offset is confirmed. With the camera now honest, the near headrest cover is clearly too small. It is 89 x 93 px with its top at y 140, against the photo's ~115 x 115 (mask bbox 106 x 110, area >= 5119 vs 4123) with its top at 178. Correcting the vertical-scale residual would shrink the render cover further. My w46 claim that 'with the camera fixed the headrest cover matches' (based on my c4 guess camera) is therefore retracted, and the headrest drops from 8.55 to 8.3. The new camera also exposes a double white bar at every aisle-end arm. It comes from my own w34a-5 request (+4.5 cm), which was made at the old, wrong camera.

issues.title: At the resected q17 camera the headrest cover is ~25 % too small and sits high; the head cushion has no forward bulge
issues.evidence: covers.png / near17.png: the near cover is 89 x 93 px, area 4123, top y 140, against y_47303's ~115 x 115, area >= 5119, top 178. The photo's head cushion wing protrudes to the right of and below the flap, reaching about y 300. The render's head zone is flat, with the pad ending at about y 235. The q15 head-on cover width matches (73 vs 71 px), so the shortfall is in depth and drop, not width.
issues.fix: Bring the head cushion's front face forward 4-6 cm with rounded wings, so the cover drapes over a convex block. Lengthen the cover's front flap about 3-4 cm downward, keeping its head-on width. Extend the pad's lower edge about 4 cm.
issues.check: q17 near cover component area >= 4900 px, height >= 105 px; q15 E run 68-76.

issues.title: Aisle-end arms read as two stacked white bars; the lower member should sit ~30 px lower and slope down toward the front (revert w34a-5)
issues.evidence: arm17.png, column x 600: render cap 416-440, then a lower pill 446-470 (1-row gap). y_47303: cap 419-434 plus a grey underside to 446, dark to 479, then the lower member 480-492, sloping (x 640: 463; x 560: 482). The end plate (y 0.507-0.588) was raised 4.5 cm in w34 at my request (w34a-5), measured at the old, wrong camera.
issues.fix: Lower the end plate about 4-5 cm (to y ~0.46-0.54) and give it a forward-down slope of about 3 cm over its length. Optionally darken its upper face to a satin grey, so the arm cap stays the single bright bar.
issues.check: At q17 x 600 the white runs are a cap of <= 20 px, then >= 20 px non-white, then the lower member; at x 560 the lower member is >= 12 px lower than at x 640.

issues.title: Seat-back pocket is a thin strip; y_47303 shows two large bulging mesh pouches
issues.evidence: pocket17.png: on the near left back the render's mesh band is about 11-15 px tall under the flap. y_47303 shows two bowed light-grey mesh pouches about 70-90 px tall (y ~345-440) with the card standing out of them.
issues.fix: Make the mesh pouches about 15-18 cm tall from the flap down, bowed out 3-4 cm at the bottom, with the lit-grey mesh and the card top showing above.
issues.check: q17 near left mesh height >= 50 px.

issues.title: q17 camera residual: upper landmarks +25-30 px while the arm noses match
